title: chronus.rf.v1
description: One receiver measurement, sent as a single JSON object per UDP datagram (at most 2048 bytes) to the gateway's rf.bind_addr. Any subset of the measurements may be present; a check without its measurement is skipped. Unknown fields are ignored.

t.description: When the measurement was taken (UTC). Omit it to have the gateway stamp the arrival time.

az_deg.description: Measured antenna azimuth, clockwise from true north (pointing check; needs el_deg too).

el_deg.description: Measured antenna elevation above the horizon (pointing check; needs az_deg too).
